explication: XGBoost is a portable gradient-boosting library. The principal workflow is: a Python, JVM, R, or C user supplies tabular data; bindings create matrix representations; the learner computes objectives and metrics while fitting tree or linear boosters; the predictor returns scores, explanations, or serialized models. Distributed Dask/Spark execution, external-memory data, categorical features, checkpointing, and CPU/CUDA/SYCL execution are represented as branches. Some relationships rely on documented capabilities because only sampled source excerpts were available.
